library.name: Google APIs Client Library for PHP (and Composer dependencies)
library.description: google/apiclient pruned to the Classroom, Drive, Calendar, Forms and Oauth2 services, plus its dependencies (google/auth, guzzlehttp/guzzle, guzzlehttp/psr7, guzzlehttp/promises, psr/*, monolog/monolog, firebase/php-jwt, ralouphie/getallheaders, symfony polyfills). Managed with the composer.json at the plugin root.
